name: Subcellular spatial transcriptomics platform benchmark
description: Systematically evaluates high-throughput subcellular spatial transcriptomics platforms across human tumors to measure resolution, sensitivity, accuracy of subcellular localization, and reproducibility.
evaluation_method: composite_score (combination of F1/precision-recall for localization, sensitivity/limit-of-detection, resolution metrics, and reproducibility statistics)
reputation: Niche, used primarily by spatial transcriptomics and computational pathology researchers; limited visibility outside the subfield.
notes: Experimental/bench dataset — susceptible to batch effects, tissue heterogeneity, and contamination; platform-specific biases and limited sample sizes can affect generalizability; non-LLM benchmark focused on wet-lab + computational metrics.
